kashika: व्यवहिताश्च गत्युपसर्गसंज्ञकाः छन्दसि दृश्यन्ते। आ म॒न्द्रैरि॑न्द्र॒ हरि॑भिर्या॒हि म॒यूर॑रोमभिः (ऋ० ३.४५.१)। आ या॑हि (ऋ० ६.१६.१०)॥
kashikaEnglish: In the Vedas, gati/upasarga may be separated from the verb: उप प्रयोभिरागतम्.
englishFull:
In Vedic literature, गति and उपसर्ग may be separated from the verb by intervening words.

**Example:** इन्द्र वायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरागतम्
"O Indra and Vāyu, these (soma juices) are pressed — come with your teams"

Here उप and आगतम् are separated by other words.

**Classical Sanskrit:** No such separation allowed — prefix must be adjacent to verb.
